testInfo.title: ETS 2026 — Full Test 05
testInfo.description: Đề thi TOEIC L&R chính thức ETS 2026 — Test 5 (200 câu, 120 phút). Đề minh hoạ phục vụ học tập.

options.text: She's pushing a large container down a hallway.
She's looking at information on a laptop screen.
She's placing a hat on top of a file cabinet.

questions.explanation:
(A) Cô ấy đang đẩy một container lớn xuống hành lang.
(B) Cô ấy đang xem thông tin trên màn hình laptop.
(C) Cô ấy đang sắp xếp các tập hồ sơ giấy.
(D) Cô ấy đang đặt một chiếc mũ lên trên tủ hồ sơ.

A worker is using a machine to move some boxes.

questions.explanation:

questions.explanation:

questions.text: Where did you put the invoice from Stanson Incorporated?

options.text: The post office is crowded today.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Where → trả lời nơi chốn: trên bàn làm việc.

questions.text: Is the inspector coming this afternoon or tomorrow morning?

options.text: I'll take the next right turn.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → chọn ngày mai.

questions.text: What's the total cost to remodel the office lobby?

options.text: The view from this window is great.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi What's the total cost → trả lời số tiền.

questions.text: Are you getting the same type of desk or a different one?

options.text: I can pick it up for you.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → trả lời cùng loại.

questions.text: We're taking the clients to the theater this evening.
questions.explanation: Tuyên bố → đáp lại đặt xe taxi để đi.

questions.text: When is your budget report due?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi When → muộn nhất là thứ Ba.

questions.text: Who can I talk to about getting a membership at this fitness center?

options.text: I can help you with that.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Who → người nói có thể giúp.

questions.text: Are you planning to buy a house in the city?

options.text: I'll be waiting at the post office.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → trả lời không muốn chuyển đi.

questions.text: How did you decide on a venue for the fund-raising event?

options.text: I got a recommendation from a friend.
To buy books for the library.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi How → nhận lời giới thiệu từ bạn.

questions.text: Could you help Ms. Ishida update the expense reports?

options.text: I'll have time after my meeting.

questions.explanation: Yêu cầu giúp → sẽ có thời gian sau cuộc họp.

questions.text: The sales representatives really appreciated the training we led.

options.text: No, but there is a manual online.
Yes, they seemed to find it helpful.

questions.explanation: Tuyên bố → xác nhận họ thấy hữu ích.

questions.text: Do you know who was promoted to senior director?

options.text: I received my promotional gift yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → chưa được công bố.

questions.text: Isn't the registration deadline tomorrow?

options.text: Here's a map that you can use.
My office is on the ninth floor.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi phủ định → đính chính: tuần sau.

questions.text: Would you like some help installing that new software?

options.text: No, I'm sure we sent it out yesterday.
Thanks, but I know how to do it.

questions.explanation: Đề nghị giúp → cảm ơn nhưng tự biết làm.

questions.text: Our factory makes the best cookies in the city.
questions.explanation: Tuyên bố → đồng tình hỏi lại.

questions.text: The fruit market is still selling mangoes, isn't it?

options.text: There's a waiting area in the lobby.
Yes, I bought some there yesterday.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi → xác nhận đã mua hôm qua.

questions.text: Why are you staying in the office for lunch?

options.text: Just a salad and soup, please.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Why → vì trời mưa.

questions.text: How did the company basketball team play last night?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi How → trận đấu bị hủy nên không có thông tin.

questions.text: Isn't our department's quarterly report supposed to be sent out today?

options.text: There's a lot of information to include.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi → có nhiều thông tin cần đưa vào nên cần thêm thời gian.

questions.text: Would you like a copy of the article I mentioned?
questions.explanation: Đề nghị → cảm ơn chấp nhận.

questions.text: Did you decide on the design for the new logo?

options.text: There are so many good options.
Please adjust that sign by the door.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Yes/No → trả lời gián tiếp: chưa quyết được vì nhiều lựa chọn tốt.

questions.text: Our bookstore is having a sale today, isn't it?

options.text: Sure, you can use my printer.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi đuôi → xác nhận nhưng chỉ giảm nhỏ.

questions.text: Why haven't the painters arrived yet?

options.text: The keys are in the desk drawer.
I heard that traffic is heavy this morning.

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi Why → vì giao thông đông đúc.

questions.text: Should I bring some flowers or some food to the party?

options.text: Don't you live next to a florist's shop?

questions.explanation: Câu hỏi lựa chọn → trả lời gián tiếp gợi ý chọn hoa (sống gần tiệm hoa).

questions.text: The meeting can wait until tomorrow.

options.text: I'll make sure the room is set up.

questions.explanation: Tuyên bố → đáp lại sẽ chuẩn bị phòng họp.

options.text: Greet a client in the lobby

questions.text: Mr. Choi, who recently joined the advisory board, is an experienced accountant ------- investor.
questions.explanation: Cần liên từ nối hai danh từ song hành → and.

questions.text: The first 150 visitors to the new fitness park will each receive a complimentary water -------.
questions.explanation: water bottle = chai nước (danh từ ghép).

questions.text: Operating instructions for the printer will be e-mailed to employees -------.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ shortly = sớm thôi.

questions.text: Dozens of ------- customers have posted positive reviews of Stellenbosch Cycle Works.
questions.explanation: satisfied customers = khách hàng hài lòng (phân từ làm tính từ).

questions.text: Ms. Lim's best-selling novel has been ------- praised.
questions.explanation: widely praised = được ca ngợi rộng rãi.

questions.text: The marketing manager, Ms. Abyola, plans to meet with the press following ------- meeting with the vice president.
questions.explanation: Đại từ sở hữu trước danh từ meeting → her.

questions.text: Last weekend, Terriville Community Center held a ------- game night for neighborhood children.
questions.explanation: lively game night = đêm trò chơi sôi động.

questions.text: Mr. Lenthe will distribute ------- of the workshop agenda to all managers by Tuesday morning.
questions.explanation: copies of = các bản sao (số nhiều).

questions.text: Employees are eligible for more vacation time ------- they have been employed for five years.
questions.explanation: after they have been employed = sau khi đã làm việc.

questions.text: Managers at Afton Accounting are urged to provide ------- feedback to employees on a regular basis.
questions.explanation: constructive feedback = phản hồi xây dựng.

questions.text: Many farmers markets operate on a seasonal -------, opening in spring and closing in late autumn.
questions.explanation: on a seasonal basis = theo mùa.

questions.text: ------- in the housing market has continued to drag down real estate profits.
questions.explanation: Weakness = sự suy yếu (danh từ làm chủ ngữ).

questions.text: The sudden merger of Alvy Brothers and Craford Enterprises ------- most financial analysts.
questions.explanation: surprised = làm ngạc nhiên.

questions.text: Of all the mistakes people make in the office, not proofreading their e-mails is one of the -------.
questions.explanation: one of the most common = một trong những phổ biến nhất.

questions.text: Cayfair Global's ------- mission is to transport and deliver client goods in a timely manner.
questions.explanation: primary mission = nhiệm vụ chính.

questions.text: The department supervisor is ------- for ensuring that all safety gear is stowed properly at the end of the shift.
questions.explanation: be responsible for = chịu trách nhiệm về.

questions.text: A three-year project deepened the -------, allowing it to accommodate the largest cargo ships.
questions.explanation: deepened the harbor = nạo sâu cảng.

questions.text: The experiment's initial results were ------- different from what was expected.
questions.explanation: wildly different = khác biệt hoàn toàn (trạng từ).

questions.text: ------- critical reviews, the movie was a great success at the box office.
questions.explanation: Despite critical reviews = mặc dù bị đánh giá tiêu cực.

questions.text: The spray-on sealant ------- as a protective layer that keeps your tiles from getting scratched.
questions.explanation: acts as = hoạt động như.

questions.text: The contract for the renovation of the park will not be awarded ------- all bids have been submitted.
questions.explanation: not be awarded until = cho đến khi nộp xong.

questions.text: A recent study showed that substituting refined sugars with maple syrup may have some important ------- benefits.
questions.explanation: health benefits = lợi ích sức khỏe.

questions.text: Margie Fung was ------- the winners at Sternetz Institute's art competition.
questions.explanation: among the winners = trong số người thắng.

questions.text: Posting updates too infrequently on social media can cause small businesses ------- by their customers.
questions.explanation: cause sb to be forgotten = bị quên (bị động nguyên mẫu).

questions.text: Ideal for conference rooms, our soundproof panels have been specially designed to ------- unwanted background noise.
